parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State how Newton's third law applies to the collision between the ball and the ground.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: The ball is in contact with the ground for a time of $0.091\text{ s}$. The ball rebounds vertically and leaves the ground with speed $5.4\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The mass of the ball is $0.059\text{ kg}$.
parts.text: Calculate the magnitude of the change in momentum of the ball during the collision.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the magnitude of the average resultant force that acts on the ball during the collision.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answer in (c)(ii) to calculate the magnitude of the average force exerted by the ground on the ball during the collision.
